decisions.reason: The broad dietary supplement range is anchored in the firm's established pharmacy consumer health business and supports its strategy of broadening the consumer portfolio, so withdrawal is unlikely despite no recent website observations.
The skin and hair supplement sits within an established pharmacy line and costs little to maintain, though the lack of website presence in 2020-2021 suggests modest sales and some risk of pruning.
The Trivital joint supplement extends a known brand into a large, ageing pharmacy customer segment, which justifies keeping it.

The OTC triptan uses the firm's pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory strengths in a solid self-medication niche, and missing website archives are more likely a data gap than a sign of withdrawal.
